spans.s:
Sadhri is the name of a ṛṣi in the Rigveda.
Foot notes v. 44, 10. Cf. Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 139.

Sādhāraṇī in one passage of the Rigveda seems to refer not so much to an uxor communis, like Draupadī in the Epic, as Max Müller suggests, but to a courtezan.
Foot notes i. 167, 4.
Sacred Books of the East, 32, 277.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 332; Muir, Sanskrit Texts, 5, 461; Pischel and Geldner, Vedische Studien, 1, xxv.
